collections.title: Compose shared UI — reviewed layout fixtures
collections.text: Actual Compose/Skiko renders, not native device screenshots. The supplied working-tree render files were refreshed on 2026-09-09 around 17:53–17:54 UTC. Files named large-text use font scale 2.0; others use 1.0. The 37 gameplay originals match the separately preserved, reviewed 17:15 suite byte for byte.
collections.status: Reviewed fixture coverage for compact, large-text, landscape and tablet layouts. The exact immutable source revision of these working-tree renders was not recorded. Native bars, keyboard behavior, accessibility and mobile font scaling require separate evidence.

collections.title: Godot 2D — iteration 01, desktop structural fixture
collections.text: Actual Godot 4.7.2.stable.official.ed1daf0bf rendering at 1280 × 800, text scale 1.0, under Xvfb. OpenGL 4.5 Compatibility / Mesa llvmpipe 25.2.8, LLVM 20.1.2. Capture source was a working tree over the basis revision below, including uncommitted implementation changes.
collections.status: Early structural design fixture with synthetic recipient-safe data, not a game-authority-generated view. The supplied report records actual reveal, select cards 0 and 4, cover and foreground/background input checks. It does not prove authority-accepted actions or native mobile accessibility. Known iteration issues: selected checkmark occlusion and unnecessary desktop body scrolling.

collections.title: Earlier Android optimized review — c73a659
collections.platform: Android API 36 emulator, optimized test-signed APK
collections.text: API 36 AVD; 1080 × 2400 pixels; 420 dpi; three-button navigation. Normal font scale is 1.0; large-text captures and final-screen.png use 2.0. These older captures do not show a software keyboard. CI run number was not independently established in the retained provenance.
collections.status: Historical evidence, superseded by the API 35 capture set for current review. Smoke failed during malformed 200% Join text replacement. The large-text final-rule image shows only a sliver of that rule, so it does not establish complete rule visibility.

collections.title: Earlier Compose review — first render
collections.text: First reviewed working-tree captures from 2026-09-09 around 15:54–15:55 UTC. Based on 7a4f8b8 with uncommitted implementation changes; these are not images of that commit alone. Density 1; large-text files use font scale 2.0.
collections.status: Historical comparisons retain the original Home hierarchy/landscape clipping, concealed claim clipping, selected-label wrapping and below-fold outcome issues. Use the current Compose collection for the later reviewed state.

collections.title: Godot 2D — iteration 01, phone and landscape history
collections.status: Phone and landscape reports passed their bounded static renderer checks. The 200% attempt failed input reachability: pinned header/actions left almost no content viewport. That failed attempt produced one PNG and diagnostic JSON, with no success report. Iteration 01 also hides the selection checkmark behind the card and places the phone hand below the seats.
collections.text: Actual Godot 4.7.2.stable.official.ed1daf0bf rendering under Xvfb, OpenGL 4.5 Compatibility / Mesa llvmpipe 25.2.8, LLVM 20.1.2. The source was a shared working tree over the stated basis, including uncommitted changes; no exact capture commit is claimed.

collections.title: Godot 2D — iteration 02, authority-derived layout fixtures
collections.status: All four reports passed their bounded static renderer layout/privacy checks using recipient-safe launch fixtures generated by the real Kotlin LastLightEngine. These captures do not prove an action was accepted by the authority. Selection badges are now visible and the phone hand precedes seats. Remaining design issues: the desktop selection hint is partly clipped by the action dock; the initial 200% and short-landscape viewports spend too much space on the rank/decorative table before Reveal.
